stem: Exploratory Spark analysis is bursty a few hours per week. Which factor most favors Athena Spark notebooks over a long-running EMR cluster?

options.label: A
options.body: Serverless on-demand compute that avoids paying for idle cluster capacity

options.label: B
options.body: Need for persistent HDFS with custom bootstrap AMI deep customization

options.label: C
options.body: Requirement to pin exact EC2 instance families for years

options.label: D
options.body: Need for OS-level SSH into every executor host daily

explanation: Athena Spark notebooks suit intermittent exploration without idle cluster cost.
